title: ReconciliationWorkflowInput
description: Input for ReconciliationWorkflow. Started by a Temporal Schedule (every 5 min + on orchestrator startup). One run per (tenant_id, strategy_id, broker_env) compares the OrderIntentJournal against the broker's open-order list and emits audit events for any discrepancies.

broker_target.description: Routes journal_dump_open + broker_list_open_orders Activities to the broker-<value> task queue. Phase 2c.2: <provider>-<env> shape (e.g. alpaca-paper). The legacy bare paper/live values are admitted ONLY for deserialization of pre-2c.2 records; using them for active reconciliation produces a non-retryable InvalidBrokerTargetError because no worker polls broker-paper / broker-live.
